results.evidence: Session start with uncertainty about where to begin matches the navigation use case exactly.
Asking what skills are available is a direct navigation-map request.
Explicit ambiguity between skills is the core dispatch trigger.
'Lay of the land for this skill pack' is a navigation map request.
Verbatim match to the description's 'navigation map of what's installed' phrasing.
Generic skill-selection question maps to the dispatcher role.
Asking how to pick a skill is exactly the discovery use case.
New-user disorientation aligns with session-start uncertainty trigger.
Concrete edit task; router would pick no skill or a code-edit skill.
Failing test debugging routes to systematic-debugging.
Explicit TDD request routes to tdd-mutation.
Writing a spec routes to the spec skill.
Creating a new skill routes to creating-skills.
Framework choice is a language/tooling question, not skill dispatch.
Style guide question is language-specific, not skill navigation.
